label: Initial balance low (prior UTC day)
gloss: the lowest price of the previous completed UTC day's first 60 minutes

label: Volume point of control
gloss: the price bin holding the most typical-price-weighted VOLUME in the current UTC day — the volume sibling of tpoPOC, published beside it rather than replacing it, because time-at-price and volume-at-price disagree exactly where a UTC day ranged quietly or trended hard. Null where the UTC day traded nothing the fold can see — a point-in-time read at its own fold; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume value-area high
gloss: the upper edge of the current UTC day's 70% VOLUME value area — the same expansion rule as tpoVAH, over the volume tally — a point-in-time read at its own fold; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume value-area low
gloss: the lower edge of the current UTC day's 70% VOLUME value area — a point-in-time read at its own fold; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume point of control (prior UTC day)
gloss: the price bin that held the most typical-price-weighted volume in the previous completed UTC day; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume value-area high (prior UTC day)
gloss: the upper edge of the previous completed UTC day's 70% volume value area; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume value-area low (prior UTC day)
gloss: the lower edge of the previous completed UTC day's 70% volume value area; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Naked POC above
gloss: the nearest point of control above the price that no later UTC day has traded through, over the 60 retained UTC days back to the newest gap — read live, because the live range and the price decide which level qualifies — and its dist_nPocAbove composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads negative

label: Naked POC below
gloss: the nearest point of control below the price that no later UTC day has traded through, over the 60 retained UTC days back to the newest gap — read live, because the live range and the price decide which level qualifies — and its dist_nPocBelow composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads positive

label: Single print above
gloss: the low edge of the nearest single-print zone above the price in the current UTC day's letter profile, excluding a zone the price has reached since the fold — read live, because the price decides which zone is nearest — and its dist_tpoSpAbove composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads negative

label: Single print below
gloss: the high edge of the nearest single-print zone below the price in the current UTC day's letter profile, excluding a zone the price has reached since the fold — read live, because the price decides which zone is nearest — and its dist_tpoSpBelow composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads positive

label: Naked single print above
gloss: the low edge of the nearest earlier UTC day's single-print zone above the price that no later trading has touched, over the retained UTC days whose single prints were measured, back to the newest gap — read live, because the live range and the price decide which zone qualifies — and its dist_nSpAbove composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads negative

label: Naked single print below
gloss: the high edge of the nearest earlier UTC day's single-print zone below the price that no later trading has touched, over the retained UTC days whose single prints were measured, back to the newest gap — read live, because the live range and the price decide which zone qualifies — and its dist_nSpBelow composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads positive
